correctness.rationale: The 2026 recursive generator has columns \((1,x)\) for all \(x\in\mathbb F_2^m\), so row and column permutations identify it with the non-systematic \(\mathrm{RM}_2(1,m)\) generator in Kazemi--Kurz--Soljanin. Their exact theorem therefore transfers directly and supplies the two corrected facets. Independently, assigning server weight \(3\) to the unique \(e_1\) column and weight \(1\) to every other column proves \(3\lambda_1+2\sum_{i\ge2}\lambda_i\le2^m+2\): first-object recovery sets have weighted cost at least \(3\), all others at least \(2\). The displayed counterexample satisfies the 2026 caps but violates this necessary inequality for every \(m\ge3\). Exhaustive \(m=3\) recovery-set enumeration verifies the exact polytope and all vertex allocations.
